source_claim: CD PROJEKT RED's official Cyberpunk 2077 universe page names and describes Panam Palmer, Judy Álvarez, Johnny Silverhand, and Adam Smasher in its character roster. The same first-party Cyberpunk site identifies Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 as a new standalone story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077, created by CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER, and its official character roster names Talia. Together these first-party sources place all five campaign characters under the Cyberpunk franchise root.
notes: Supporting first-party roster pages: https://www.cyberpunk.net/gm/en/cyberpunk-2077 and https://www.cyberpunk.net/en/edgerunners2. The Edgerunners 2 page explicitly places the installment in the Cyberpunk 2077 world and identifies CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER as creators. This batch covers exactly the five campaign members; no adaptation-specific or second HOME edge is inferred.
